notes.title: Update 0.1.3 - Tutorial rework
notes.content: [p]Overhaul of the tutorial system to interactively progress through a flight course, more content of this type to come to help with the steep learning curve. [/p][p]Please let me know what you think, its super easy to send suggestions from the in-game feedback form.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you and have fun![/p][p]Casey[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]
